title: WiFi password reset procedure
author: Mike Johnson
body:
1. Log into router admin panel
2. Navigate to Wireless Settings
3. Change password (minimum 12 characters)
4. Update documentation
5. Notify all staff via email

title: New employee onboarding checklist
author: Lisa Chen
body:
IT Setup:
- Create email account
- Set up workstation
- Install required software
- Configure VPN access
- Assign phone extension
- Add to relevant distribution lists

title: Printer maintenance schedule
author: Mike Johnson
body:
Monthly maintenance:
- Clean print heads
- Check toner levels
- Clear paper jams
- Update firmware if available
- Test print quality
